Package org.webharvest.definition

Interface Config

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    XMLConfig
    public interface Config
    Represents lazily loaded configuration object that is loaded from associated ConfigSource on demand with call to reload() method. For already loaded configuration it is possible to get reference to a graph of configuration elements with getElementDef().
    Since:
    2.1.0-SNAPSHOT
    Version:
    %I%, %G%
    Author:
